At Tediber, we want you to be completely satisfied with your choice. That is why we offer a simple and free return policy:

Trial Periods: You have 100 nights to try our mattresses and large furniture items (such as beds, bed bases, and sofa beds) from the date of delivery. For bed linen and protectors, the trial period is 30 days.

Free Returns: All returns are entirely free. We even provide the necessary protective covers for the return of bulky items via our carrier partners.

Easy Process: To initiate a return, simply send an email with a photo of the product to hello@tediber.com or use our online form. For large items, a carrier will schedule a pickup at your home. For smaller items, we will provide a prepaid return label.

Refunds: Once the product is received or picked up, we process the refund to your original payment method. This typically takes about 72 hours after receipt for large items and up to 15 business days for others.

Feel free to contact us anytime; we're here to help.

Once again, thank you for reaching out to us. Have a fantastic day. 🙂
